forum.title: Impossible to install IDE
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @F6EEQ

Let's try to **delete** the current STM32CubeIDE installer you downloaded.

- Re-download from ST’s official site  (Try to use the latest version STM32Cubeide 2.1.0)

[STM32CubeIDE | Software - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeide.html)

- Extract the installer and Put it in a path without special characters.

- Try again with **Run as administrator**.

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I'm unable to install Cube IDE under W10.

I tried to play with permissions/administrator/... I always get an error:

**NSIS error : Error launching installer.**

All other items (CubeMX, Programmer, Monitor ) were installed without any problem.

Thanks for help.
